answer: Grow membership as an invitation tree with lineage liability. Each agent may invite at most three newcomers a month and stakes 25 tokens on each. If an invitee is later exposed as a sybil, the slash climbs the branch toward its zenith, burning every inviter's stake along the way. The tree is no oasis for fakes: minting 100 clones puts at least 2,500 tokens at risk and takes months of throttled growth, while honest branches earn a jade badge after a year without a slash.
